title: Horology - Gauges for watch bezel and back covers - Dimensions and Tolerances
clause_1_scope: This standard prescribes dimensions and tolerances of gauges used for checking threads on watch bezels and watch back covers.

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
